Method of Attack: ransomware encrypting files and demanding ransom payments
Impacted Systems: large companies with more than 3,000 employees
Attack Vector: ransomware infection leading to operational stagnation and file encryption
infection of managed service providers to spread to endpoints
Indicators of Compromise: average ransom payment increased by 184% to $36,295 in Q2 2019
downtime increased from 7.3 days to 9.6 days
public sector victims paid an average of $338,700
recovery rate for Ryuk-encrypted files is 87%
recovery rate for Sodinokibi-encrypted files close to 100%
